response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), scored AS (SELECT zoneregistry, insurstat, ratio, mesh_count, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_avg FROM site_ratio WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_avg_sites, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM scored WHERE ratio > status_avg GROUP BY insurstat

assumptions.assumption: A geomdeltamm of 0 gives a missing ratio (NULLIF avoids division by zero), and missing ratios are ignored in the site averages.
A site's mesh count includes all its matching mesh records, even those whose ratio is missing.
Sites whose ratios are all missing have no site ratio, so they are left out of the status average and of the above-average comparison.
Only NULL insurstat counts as 'no recorded insurance status'.
